messages:
Maria (Product): Quick kickoff — we need to finalize the instrumentation acceptance checklist for the Console Observability MVP. Targeting next release cycle. High-level customer asks: per-route token-level cost, trace hooks through the inference path, top errors by model+route, and flexible sampling controls. Proposed minimal signals: request_start/request_end, model_id, model_version, route, latency_ms, tokens_in, tokens_out, error_type, user_id_hash, trace_id. Can we align on that as the baseline?

Diego (Eng): +1. Two implementation questions: 1) default sampling rate — 1%? 2) do we ever include prompt text in traces? my vote: no, only fingerprints/fingerprints+ids (privacy).

Maria (Product): Agreed — no raw prompts. Sampling: default 1% but we should expose dynamic sampling API and per-customer overrides. We'll add that to acceptance.

Priya (SRE): For SLOs we need traces that capture tail latency (p95/p99) and span breakdowns (tokenization, model_run, network). Also we must ensure request_id <-> trace_id mapping. For Dedicated customers, add a toggle to enable full KV/cache logs for diagnostic mode.

Anand (Eng Platform): Implementation note: we'll emit a compact proto with the fields above and pipe to metrics + tracing backends. This requires a dataplane schema bump and a compatibility path for older agents. Rough ETA for the minimal emitter: 2 sprints if no surprises.

Laura (Customer Success): Customers keep asking for a per-route and per-model cost breakdown view — they expect near-real-time (sub-minute) dashboards and CSV export for chargeback. Also they want to be able to see which customers are driving token spend (anonymized).

Tom (Design): For dashboards I propose four primary views: Overview (KPIs: tokens, cost, p95 latency), Model Cost Breakdown (per-model, per-route, filterable), Latency Heatmap (region/instance), Error Explorer (error buckets + sample traces). I'll produce mid-fi mocks by EOD tomorrow.

Maria (Product): Draft launch criteria so we can be concrete: 1) Dashboard shows per-route cost and p95 latency with filter + export. 2) Trace hooks instrumented end-to-end for at least two representative models. 3) Error explorer surfaces top 5 error buckets with drilldown to trace samples. 4) Sampling controls and privacy guardrails documented and enabled. Anything to add/remove?

Diego (Eng): Add automated alerting for sudden cost spikes and error rate regressions. Also flag: older runtime customers might not emit model_version; we'll need fallback logic in dashboards.

Priya (SRE): Agree on alerts. Suggested thresholds (initial): cost spike >30% week-over-week for a tenant or cost increase >$X/day; error rate jump >1 percentage point absolute. Retention policy suggestion: raw traces 7 days, aggregated metrics 90 days (configurable per plan).

Anand (Eng Platform): Small but important: quantized/variant builds should include model_variant tag so the dashboard can attribute cost to logical model + variant. Also we should emit a boolean "private_prompt_flag" to enforce prompt omission.

Laura (Customer Success): One more ask from enterprise accounts: a user-level sampling toggle and the ability to request temporary 100% sampling for a support window.

Maria (Product): Good call. I'll add that to the acceptance list. Summary action items: Diego — schema PR + proto by Thu; Tom — mid-fi dashboards by Wed; Priya — alerting thresholds + runbook by Fri; Anand — migration notes + feature flag for compatibility; Laura — collect 3 customer examples that need CSV export. Ping @eng-infra for infra cost estimate and retention cost calc. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: pipeline:infra-cost-check kicked off for observability-mvp (run id: a1f3).
